verdict.rationale: Bolna documents self-hosting on your own servers with Docker or Kubernetes in its on-premise instructions [bolna-docs-9], and its core voice framework is published as open source on GitHub [bolna-gh-1]. The evidence is mostly summary-level, though: the on-prem guide sits under an 'enterprise' section, and it is unclear whether self-hosting covers the full managed platform (dashboard, Agent Studio, workflows) or only the open-source framework. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting setup and requirements documentation, clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and hosted versions and whether enterprise gating applies, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.
